title: Solar and batteries in Victoria: how long until they pay for themselves?
batteryRebateEligibilityNotice: The battery rebate only applies to batteries with a nominal capacity of 5–100 kWh.
calculatorTitle: Make sense of your solar savings
intro: Use your electricity usage and installation quotes to explore potential solar and battery savings.
privacy: Calculated in your browser. Your inputs are not uploaded. Only your language preference is saved locally.
batteryOnly: Add a battery to existing solar
postcodeHint: Used to select your solar zone
feedInHint: Defaults to 0. Check your electricity bill.
billHint: The estimate deducts the supply charge, then annualises flat-rate usage. Use a bill without solar credits, discounts or other charges. With existing solar, enter total household annual usage instead.
usableHint: Use discharge-side usable capacity, not nominal capacity.
quoteIncludesRebate: Do your quotes already include STC rebates?
yesRebate: Yes — use the quoted amount payable
quoteHint: Defaults are reference prices including GST and installation, after rebates. Enter your own quote for other sizes. If rebates are not included, enter the price before rebates.
noScript: Enable JavaScript to run the calculator in your browser.
emptyText: Usage, system size and your actual quotes determine potential savings and payback.
modelNote: Four seasonal average days account for panel degradation, battery losses and throughput limits. These are estimates, not guaranteed returns.
utilisationHint: Average daily discharge ÷ usable battery capacity
oversized: Battery utilisation is low; the battery may be oversized.
noDischarge: No battery discharge; incremental payback and per-kWh metrics are unavailable.
notApplicable: Installation date is outside the policy data period; this rebate is not applicable.
rebateIncluded: Rebates are already in your quotes. These amounts are for reference and are not deducted again.
rebateDeducted: Estimated rebates above have been deducted from your pre-rebate quotes.
sensitivity: Payback and returns as electricity prices change
warrantyBasis: Battery benefits over the {years}-year warranty period
expectedBasis: Battery benefits over an expected life of {years} years
expectedNote: Uses the upper end of the government life range, not a product guarantee. Degradation and throughput limits continue after warranty.
escalationNote: Only import prices rise; feed-in tariffs stay constant. Payback is the first year cumulative savings cover cost.
batteryNoPayback: Under these assumptions, no payback during the {years} years of battery benefits
afterBattery: The whole system pays back in year {year}, after battery benefits end.
savedPerKwh: Average saving per kWh over the same period
dischargeTotal: Total discharge over the benefit period: {value} kWh
defaultsTitle: Where do the defaults come from?
usageSource: AER seasonal usage benchmark for a three-person Victorian household
assumptionsSource: Model assumptions: daytime shares, efficiency, degradation and price scenarios
inputError: Check required fields, dates and number ranges.
postcodeError: Enter a supported four-digit Victorian postcode.
billError: Cannot estimate usage from this bill. Check its total, billing days and tariff.
calculationError: Check tariffs, capacities and quotes. Pre-rebate quotes must cover the corresponding estimated rebate. Excessively large inputs cannot be calculated.
seasonalSource: BOM sunlight and AER seasonal usage
